theorem: M_n(C) (n>=2) simple => no nonzero character (no multiplicative hom to C)
contradiction: x_ii equal + sum=1 => x_ii=1/2, but idempotent => x_ii in {0,1}: contradiction
conclusion: M_n has NO character (P1: no point). Diagonal (abelian/MASA) HAS character = evaluation (point). 'noncommutative -> commutative' is the wall, and the finite-dim version is exact here.
